title: Externally controlled trials (FDA 2023 draft)
source_note: FDA Considerations for the Design and Conduct of Externally Controlled Trials (draft, Feb 2023)

items.title: Design justification
items.requirement: Why an external control is appropriate instead of (or in addition to) concurrent randomisation is justified.
items.query: appropriateness of externally controlled trial design

items.title: Pre-specification
items.requirement: Protocol and SAP, including external data selection and analyses, are finalised before outcome data are analysed.
items.query: pre-specify protocol statistical analysis plan before external data

items.title: Data source fitness
items.requirement: Relevance and reliability of the external data source are assessed (data quality, completeness, provenance).
items.query: external data source relevance reliability quality

items.title: Comparability of populations
items.requirement: Eligibility criteria are applied equivalently and index date / time zero is aligned.
items.query: comparability eligibility criteria index date time zero

items.title: Treatment attributes
items.requirement: Treatment and concomitant-care differences between arms are described.

items.title: Outcome comparability
items.requirement: Outcome definitions, assessment timing and ascertainment are comparable between arms.

items.title: Confounding control
items.requirement: Important confounders are identified and the adjustment method (e.g. propensity scores) with balance diagnostics is specified.
items.query: confounding baseline covariates propensity score balance

items.title: Missing data
items.requirement: Missing data in the external source and their handling are addressed.

items.title: Sensitivity / bias analysis
items.requirement: Sensitivity and quantitative bias analyses for unmeasured confounding are planned.
items.query: sensitivity analyses quantitative bias unmeasured confounding

items.title: Regulatory interaction and data access
items.requirement: Early FDA interaction is planned and patient-level external data can be provided.
items.query: patient-level data submission FDA early discussion
